title: Otter to Docketwise Case Notes System - Meetings and Calls

sections.label: 1 · IN PERSON MEETINGS RECORDED IN OTTER
sections.note: Otter finishes a client meeting and we go straight to the Microsoft 365 appointment it belongs to. If the appointment does not name the case, Claude reads the transcript for it.

sections.label: 2 · RINGCENTRAL PHONE CALLS
sections.note: A recorded call arrives with its caller ID. The phone number is looked up against Docketwise contacts, then it joins the same matching gate the meetings use.

sections.label: 3 · MATCH IT TO THE RIGHT MATTER
sections.note: One matter, or nobody guesses. Anything ambiguous goes to a person by email before a single word is written to a file.

sections.label: 4 · WRITE THE CASE NOTE
sections.note: Claude turns the transcript into a case note a paralegal would write: decisions, deadlines, follow-ups. It is posted to the matter in Docketwise.

sections.label: 5 · AUDIT LOG AND FAILURE ALERTS
sections.note: Every note filed is logged with its source and matter. Anything that errors emails the office instead of disappearing quietly.

nodes.label: 1 · Otter AI: Meeting Transcript Ready
nodes.notes: Fires when Otter finishes processing a recorded in person meeting.

nodes.label: 2 · Microsoft 365: Find the Calendar Appointment for This Meeting
nodes.notes: Matches on the attorney's calendar by start time and attendees.

nodes.label: 3 · Pull Client Name and Case Number From the Appointment
nodes.notes: Reads the subject, body and attendee list for a client name or case file number.

nodes.label: 5 · Claude: Extract Client and Case References From the Transcript
nodes.notes: For meetings booked without case details, it reads what was said out loud in the room.

nodes.label: 6 · RingCentral: Call Recording Available
nodes.notes: Fires the moment a recorded call ends.

nodes.label: 7 · RingCentral: Fetch the Recording and Caller ID
8 · Docketwise: Match Contact by Phone Number
nodes.notes: The caller ID is the fastest identifier we have on a phone call.

nodes.label: 9 · Docketwise: Search Matter by Client or Case Number
10 · Exactly One Matter Matched?
nodes.notes: Zero matches or two matches both count as no match.

nodes.label: 11 · Email Staff to Confirm Which Matter This Belongs To
nodes.notes: Holds the transcript until a person picks the matter. Nothing is filed on a guess.

nodes.label: 12 · Claude: Summarize Into a Case Note With Decisions, Deadlines and Follow Ups
13 · Docketwise: Add the Note to the Matter
14 · Audit Log: Source, Matter and Link to the Note
nodes.notes: One row per filed note so the office can prove where every note came from.

nodes.label: 15 · Something Failed Anywhere in the Flow
16 · Email the Office With the Transcript That Did Not File
